props.name: animation
props.description: Entry and update animations, skipped when the user prefers reduced motion (default `true`)

props.name: deep
props.description:
Also follows in-place mutations of nested data (`series[0].data.push()`);
by default the chart updates when a prop is replaced (cheaper on large data)

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; clicking an item hides / shows its slice, stage or series (shown by default for pie, donut, funnel and multi-series radar charts)

props.name: headers
props.description: Draws the names of the parents above their children (default `true`)

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the shapes: `auto` tries WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D, skipping GPUs running in software; text is always drawn with Canvas2D (default `auto`, see `setDefaultChartRenderer`)

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels (default `100%`)

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels, strings any CSS length

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the drawing, in pixels (default 8 on every side)

props.name: palette
props.description: Colors of the marks without `color` (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` CSS variables, then the theme colors)

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart (default: the chart type, e.g. "Donut chart")

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale of the texts and numbers the engine writes (tooltip rows, accessible names, compact numbers); the page language by default

props.name: hidden
props.description:
Hidden slices / stages / radar series / top-level treemap nodes, by
index. Makes the visibility controlled: legend clicks then only emit
`toggle`, whose `hiddenIndexes` should be stored and passed back.

props.name: texts
props.description: Replaces built-in texts of the `locale` (tooltip rows, accessible names, "No data")

props.name: data
props.description: Nodes `{ name, value, children }`: leaves carry a value, parents sum their children

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the values of the labels and the tooltip (default: compact numbers, 1.2k, 3.4M)

props.name: percentFormat
props.description: Formats the shares (labels, conversion rates, tooltip); `share` is 0-1 (default: one decimal, "40.0%")

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between the cells, in pixels (default 2)

<script setup lang="ts">
// A flat list: one rectangle per node, its area proportional to the value.
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useI18n } from "minerva-design/vue";
import { TreemapChart } from "minerva-design/vue/charts";

const TEXT = {
  en: ["Asia", "Europe", "North America", "South America", "Africa", "Oceania"],
  zh: ["亚洲", "欧洲", "北美洲", "南美洲", "非洲", "大洋洲"],
  ja: ["アジア", "ヨーロッパ", "北米", "南米", "アフリカ", "オセアニア"],
  fr: [
    "Asie",
    "Europe",
    "Amérique du Nord",
    "Amérique du Sud",
    "Afrique",
    "Océanie",
  ],
};

const { language } = useI18n();
const data = computed(() =>
  [4750, 745, 600, 440, 1460, 46].map((value, i) => ({
    name: (TEXT[language.value] ?? TEXT.en)[i],
    value,
  })),
);
const format = (millions: number) => `${millions}M`;
</script>

<template>
  <TreemapChart :data="data" :gap="4" :format="format" :height="300" />
</template>

translationResources.title: Treemap
translationResources.description: Nested rectangles whose areas are proportional to the values: shows at a glance what takes up the most room in a hierarchy (disk usage, budgets, portfolios). Hover or use the arrow keys to highlight a cell; the tooltip shows its path.

basic.title: Nested
basic.description: Parents sum their children and draw their name as a header; onClick receives the path from the root to the clicked leaf.

flat.title: Flat
flat.description: Without children every node is a leaf; gap widens the space between the cells.

market-map.title: Stock market map
market-map.description: Stocks grouped by sector, sized by market capitalization and colored by the change of the day from red to green, like the market maps of finance sites; the change is part of each cell's name.

bundle.title: Bundle size
bundle.description: What a bundle analyzer shows: the modules of a JavaScript bundle by minified size, three levels deep, and the heaviest dependencies listed under the chart.

drill-down.title: Drill-down into a store catalog
drill-down.description: Clicking a category (onClick, using the first name of event.path) replaces the data with its subcategories and brands, and the breadcrumb goes back to the overview. Inside a category a click selects a brand; renderTooltip prepends the category to the path.

cloud-costs.title: Cloud costs with a legend filter
cloud-costs.description: legend={{ position: "top" }} lists the services; hidden and onToggle make the filter controlled, so a Show all button can reset it and the summary can total the services left. renderTooltip shows a resource's share of the whole bill.

live-cluster.title: Live cluster memory
live-cluster.description: The memory used by each pod is refreshed every 2 seconds (setInterval, cleared when the switch is off or on unmount) and the cells resize in place. Pods above 85 % of their limit turn red through their color, and only the list of such pods is announced.

metric-switch.title: Switching the metric
metric-switch.description: The same tree is sized by revenue, orders or profit, so switching the metric moves and resizes the cells instead of redrawing them; format follows the metric. Country names come from Intl.DisplayNames and renderTooltip lists every metric of a country.
